finding.source_fact: ControlNoBroadcastReadback.observe accepts reentry_observed as a caller-supplied boolean. ControlNoBroadcastReadback.__post_init__ rejects true, so every valid control object necessarily carries false by construction.
finding.executed_g7_fact: The accepted G7 target workflow's control subprocess explicitly emits reentry_observed=false and then passes that value into ControlNoBroadcastReadback.observe. It does not monitor a re-entry-capable control path over an explicit observation opportunity/window and derive absence from recorded events.
finding.g8_consequence: Binding G8 to the exact G4-bound ControlNoBroadcastReadback hash removes arm-label substitution but does not by itself make control-side non-reentry an independently observed negative fact. Factory origin proves construction/lineage, not absence detection.
finding.asymmetry: The intervention side can be backed by GwtRuntimeWitnessRecorder DELIVERY->UPTAKE->REENTRY events, while the current control side can only present a constructor-admitted false boolean. Treating those as symmetric causal observations would overstate evidence.

counterexample.setup: Run the current no-broadcast control subprocess in an environment where an unrelated or stale re-entry event occurs after control task start. Leave the subprocess implementation unchanged so it still emits reentry_observed=false.
counterexample.expected_current_behavior: A structurally valid ControlNoBroadcastReadback can still be built because the boolean is declared by the subprocess and the class only verifies that it is false; no observer detects the injected re-entry event.
counterexample.correct_behavior: A genuine control absence observer must detect the re-entry event or fail closed because the observation opportunity was incomplete; it must not emit NO_REENTRY solely because the caller supplied false.

required_g8_or_successor_regressions: Do not use ControlNoBroadcastReadback.reentry_observed=false alone as independent negative observation authority for semantic promotion.
Introduce or reuse a recorder that can observe both possible outcomes on the control path: REENTRY event present or no REENTRY before an explicit terminal/opportunity boundary.
Bind observation start, terminal/opportunity boundary, monotonic ordering, exact source, boot, execution context, task/input identity and process/runtime identity.
Inject a control-side re-entry event and prove the observer records/rejects it rather than allowing a caller to declare false.
Inject incomplete/aborted control observation and require UNKNOWN rather than NO_REENTRY.
Require exact observer receipt SHA to match the G8/G4-bound control evidence before mechanism comparison.
Keep mechanism-level re-entry evidence distinct from task-level semantic outcome evidence; even a valid re-entry difference must not mint semantic GWT/J-Space content credit by itself.
next_exact_action: The active WP900 G8 owner should harden the control side into a symmetric bounded absence observer or explicitly scope G8 below independent control-absence evidence. Add injected-reentry and incomplete-window hard negatives before repository acceptance. Do not dispatch a G8 target subject whose control negative is still only caller-declared false.
